note: Address Map Link adds third-party formatter settings to core Address fields that turn a displayed address into a link to an external map provider. No field type, widget, settings form, configure route (configure=null), permission, or Drush. It defines the MapLink plugin type (manager plugin.manager.map_link) with 10 shipped providers (google_maps, google_maps_directions, apple_maps, bing_maps, here_wego_maps, mapquest, openstreetmap, yandex_maps, waze_directions, waze_navigate). Its only persistent state is third-party settings on the address field's component in an entity_view_display config entity: content.<field>.third_party_settings.address_map_link.{link_address,map_link_type,map_link_position,map_link_text,map_link_new_window}. Medium/hard cases create a namespaced field_aml_* address field on node.article and read/write those settings, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: The address_map_link Drupal module links an Address field to an external map site. Name several of the map providers it ships and the setting that turns the linking on.
evals.expected_output: It ships google_maps, google_maps_directions, apple_maps, bing_maps, here_wego_maps, mapquest, openstreetmap, yandex_maps, waze_directions, waze_navigate. On an address field's formatter you tick 'Link Address to Map' (third-party setting link_address=TRUE) and pick a provider (map_link_type).

evals.prompt: In address_map_link, there is no settings page. Where are the map-link options (link on/off, provider, position) stored for a given address field, and how do I enable them?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. You open the bundle's Manage display, open the Address field's formatter settings, tick 'Link Address to Map' and choose a provider. It is stored as third-party settings on the field's component in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<view_mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.address_map_link.{link_address,map_link_type,map_link_position,map_link_text,map_link_new_window}.

evals.prompt: How can I build a map URL from an Address field in custom PHP with the address_map_link module, without using the field formatter? Name the service and the method.
evals.expected_output: Use the plugin.manager.map_link service: $manager->createInstance('google_maps_directions')->getAddressUrl($address)->toString(), where $address is an AddressInterface (e.g. $entity->field_address->first()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an Address field (field_aml_known) that address_map_link has turned into a map link. Inspect the live default view display for Article and state which map provider (map_link_type) that field is linked to.
evals.expected_output: field_aml_known is linked to waze_directions: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component has third_party_settings.address_map_link.link_address: true and map_link_type: waze_directions.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an Address field field_aml_win with an address_map_link map link. Inspect the live view-display configuration and report which map provider it uses and whether the link opens in a new window.
evals.expected_output: field_aml_win links to openstreetmap and opens in a new window: third_party_settings.address_map_link.map_link_type == 'openstreetmap' and map_link_new_window == true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an Address field field_aml_task shown with the Address (address_default) formatter, but it is not linked to a map. Using the address_map_link module, configure the default view display so this field links to the 'Google Maps - Directions' provider (map_link_type google_maps_directions). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_aml_task component has third_party_settings.address_map_link.link_address: true and map_link_type: google_maps_directions.

evals.prompt: On my site, the Store address on Article pages (the field_aml_store address field) is just plain text. Make that address a clickable link that opens Apple Maps. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_aml_store component has third_party_settings.address_map_link.link_address: true and map_link_type: apple_maps.
